caveats: Region bounds contain no grid-cell centres exactly at the limits; the analysed grid cells have lat 54.14..55.32 N and lon 14.68..15.86 E (all cells within the inclusive bounds, 60x60). Sea cells (3301 of 3600) are cells with finite SST on every target day. Baseline pools use the 1991-12-27..1991-12-31 and 2003-01-01..2003-01-05 edge days required by the +-5-day windows around baseline dates; day-of-year 60 (29 February) has no pool of its own and was filled with the mean of days 59 and 61 before smoothing. Land cells are 0 in the mask.
